name: two of swords
source:
A short visual novel about an autistic trans girl trying to understand the meaning of life.

It's like part choose-your-own tarot adventure, part personally quiz, and part turn based battle.

[Edited from [url=https://weepingwitch.itch.io/two-of-swords]itch.io[/url]]
